title: Amazing: The Rebuilding the MacArthur Maze (Documentary)
summary: A half-hour television special on the 2007 fiery collapse of a connector in the Bay Area's MacArthur Maze and its rebuilding in 26 days. It was produced for the Professional Engineers in California Government.
why: HN cites it as proof that infrastructure can be rebuilt very fast when incentives and urgency line up.

quote.text: The overpass collapsed on April 29th. They had it reopened to traffic 26 days later.
